description: Search claims by text, subject, agent, status, authz_ref (the sha256 of an authorized plan) or depends_on (cd-1b: the parent claims that list a given claim id). Each item carries receipt_url, counts_as_verified and limits. Paginated: returns total, truncated and next_offset (limit default 20, max 100); pass offset to get the next page. ar-1: a targeted search (subject, host or agent) with no public match returns receipt_request, a copy-paste line to ask the claimant for a receipt (names a bare public hostname only).

authz_ref.description: az-1: sha256:<64 hex> of an authorized plan; returns the claims committed to it

depends_on.description: cd-1b reverse lookup: one claim id; returns the public parent claims that list it in depends_on (who relies on this claim)

host.description: fc-1: bare hostname filter matching subject or check URLs/hosts

name: search_claims
title: Search claims
